**The Warriors Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)** adds right-stick controls, aspect ratio correction, optional 60 FPS, and faster game loading.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#thewarriors) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix/main.cpp)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Ultrawide** — Support ultrawide display ratios with PPSSPP 1.14 and above.

## Options

- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros.
- **Dual analog controls** — Enable right-stick camera movement and keep the left stick for movement. On by default; off in Vanilla.
- **60 FPS** — Optional 60 FPS mode.
- **Aspect ratio** — Override the aspect ratio; `auto` follows the emulator display instead of the original 16:10.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.

![PPSSPPWindows64_2022_12_23_16_04_26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4904157/209387701-75952568-fcdf-4a3c-876d-46c8cb38d645.png)

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Launch the game in PPSSPP once to create `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix.cfg`.
4. Change settings on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub, then restart the emulated game.



## Settings and compatibility

Intro skipping and faster loading are enabled by default; 60 FPS is off and aspect ratio is Automatic. Settings are saved in `TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix.cfg`. Changes apply the next time the emulated game starts. An old `TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini` isn't used anymore and can be deleted; keep the supplied `plugin.ini`.

Automatic aspect follows the emulator. Enter a width:height ratio to override it, or 0 to keep the original picture and HUD. Right-stick camera controls are enabled by default on supported releases and can be turned off, with the game's camera inversion option and independent left-stick movement. Choose anti-aliasing in PPSSPP. There is no in-game settings menu.

## Presets and FusionFixHub

- Presets: Vanilla turns off skip intro, dual analog controls and fast loading; Recommended (the defaults) turns them on; Enhanced also turns on 60 FPS. The aspect ratio is the player's choice and no preset changes it.
- Setting texts: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
